(29 question-marked messages after removing 4 bare URLs, plus ~15 unpunctuated asks such as 'do you think these are too risky for trial reels'); multi-message asks counted once. 'Unanswered >24h' = never answered or answered only after 24h with no substance: talking-to-camera examples (Jul 22, 43d), collab-account ask (Jul 23, never), X ownership (Jul 28, ~2d), Aug 6 status check-in (only 'Yo Ma'am'), backup IG @ chase (Aug 3, 32d), engagement-software (Aug 11, 24d), linkme decision (Aug 11, 24d), 'is this too risqué' (Aug 18, never), Aug 24 traffic escalation (11d), Aug 24 OFTV-pivot yes/no (11d), Aug 24 domain review (11d).
